name: Artemis IV
first: First crewed mission to the Lunar Gateway; second crewed lunar landing
description: Artemis IV is planned as the first crewed mission to visit the Lunar Gateway, NASA's small space station in Near-Rectilinear Halo Orbit (NRHO) around the Moon. It debuts the more powerful SLS Block 1B, whose new Exploration Upper Stage (EUS) lets a single launch carry both Orion with 4 crew and the co-manifested I-HAB (International Habitation) module — built by ESA and JAXA — for delivery to Gateway. After docking Orion and I-HAB to the station, two crew descend to the lunar south pole aboard a SpaceX Starship Human Landing System for the program's second crewed landing, while the others tend the growing Gateway. Planned for ~2028; crew and landing site remain to be assigned.
